info.title: LunarNX
info.author: thinkzhou
info.details: LunarNX is an unofficial Xbox and PlayStation game-streaming client for Nintendo Switch homebrew. Stream from your own Xbox One or Xbox Series console, use Xbox Cloud Gaming, or connect to a paired PS4 or PS5 locally or through PSN. It features hardware-accelerated H.264 and PS5 HEVC video, low-latency audio, controller remapping, PlayStation touchpad gestures, Switch motion forwarding, in-stream statistics, and stream recovery after returning from the HOME menu. Xbox Cloud Gaming availability depends on account entitlement and region. Remote streaming depends on console settings, platform services, NAT behavior, and network quality. Launch LunarNX from Homebrew Menu using title override/full-memory mode.

changelog:
v0.3.1
0.3.1

LunarNX 0.3.1 focuses on faster reconnection, safer stream teardown, and predictable release packaging. It reuses successful Xbox and PlayStation network routes, improves cancellation and UI lifecycle handling, and publishes stable assets for Sphaira installation.

 Streaming and stability

- Reuse successful Xbox ICE and PlayStation remote routes.
- Speed up stream exit and harden asynchronous UI teardown.
- Improve cancellation handling and stream-exit rendering.

 Release and documentation

- Generate the in-app changelog from CHANGELOG.md.
- Publish stable LunarNX.nro and LunarNX.zip assets with SHA-256 checksums.

v0.3.0
- Improved Xbox and PlayStation streaming policies, packet-loss recovery, and long-session stability.
- Hardened PS4/PS5 discovery, pairing, PSN startup, haptics, HEVC, and high-bitrate playback.
- Fixed 720p rendering artifacts, controller input leakage, and audio/video recovery edge cases.
- Refreshed the About, community, support, diagnostics, and release packaging experience.
